data.name: Nishat Power Limited
data.description: Nishat Power Limited is a public company limited by shares incorporated in Pakistan on February 23, 2007 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now, the Companies Act, 2017). The company is a subsidiary of Nishat Mills Limited. The principal activity of the company is to build, own, operate and maintain a fuel fired power station having gross capacity of 200 MW in Jamber Kalan, Tehsil Pattoki, District Kasur, Punjab, Pakistan.
